positions.name: AuthoritativeKnowledgePurgeCommand
positions.frame: Is this expression issuing an authoritative command to erase or discard specific knowledge from the record, rather than requesting, informing, or describing?
positions.why: Both expressions are bare imperatives ('Forget', 'Remove all knowledge') performing the same authority-ranking, present-tense, irrealis command to purge knowledge — high-arousal negative affect, formal/technical register, decision-grade conviction, and an autonomy move claiming standing to dictate what the audience retains. src-2 narrows the scope with a concrete rule-of-three enumeration but shares the identical directional force as src-1's general command. src-3 was considered but excluded: it shifts to a calm, past-tense, realis declarative assertion (informational rather than pressuring, conservation rather than autonomy, claim rather than decision) — a different directional read even though it is thematically the stated justification for the purge.
